query:
SELECT id as "id!: Uuid",
                      issue_id as "issue_id!: Uuid",
                      related_issue_id as "related_issue_id!: Uuid",
                      relationship_type,
                      created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM issue_relationships
               WHERE issue_id = $1
               ORDER BY created_at ASC
